steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Control your distance! Close in!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Slash! Don't just rely on thrusts!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Phew!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Aim low!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Eyah!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You lost.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Franka...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: How many times have I told you? You're using a longsword. Your style may be based around rapiers, but don't rely on thrusts so much.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You don't need to apologize. Old habits die hard. It's not easy to combine those two weapons' techniques, and I'm really just coming up with this on the fly as I train you.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Um, Franka? There's actually something that I've been meaning to ask.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Mm?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: You seem to know a lot about my rapier style. Why's that?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hm... Well, before I became a mercenary, I was actually the greatest fencing teacher in all of Columbia.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: R-Really?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hehe, normally you'd have to pay the big bucks to take my lessons.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Um, so...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Just kidding. I was never a teacher.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Mnngh... Not another one of your jokes. But why then?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: You're very familiar with that particular style. If I remember correctly, last time you even said, 'have you forgotten your third lesson, on how much force to apply to a thrust?' Or something like that.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Right, I wonder why.
Control your distance! Close in!
Aim low!
Have you forgotten your third lesson, on how much force to apply to a thrust?
*Sobs*...
Eh? C'mon, don't cry. I just meant if you're here to learn fencing, you gotta put in some work, you know? I didn't mean it like that. Alright, alright. Don't cry, now.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Alright, that's enough chatter. Let's take it from the top.
Franka raises her sword, holding it right before her nose.
[[character(fadetime=0.3)]]
An opening! Strike!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: I've got a chance!
Melantha, who finally managed to threaten Franka's neck with her training sword, notices that her teacher seems to be in a bit of a trance.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Fine, you got me. This is your first win during training, isn't it Mel?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Only because you were a little... A-Anyway, I still have much to learn!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Of course. When did I say you were good enough to graduate from my classes? You still won, though, and that counts for something.
She strokes Melantha's hair.
Her usual smile has reappeared on her face.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Um... Thank you!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Right, I probably won't be at Rhodes Island much next month. Be sure to keep up your training, okay?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Um? Huh? What are you off to do, Miss Franka...?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Ah, I don't mean to pry...

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: If you're going into danger, please, make sure to stay safe.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Don't worry, it's nothing dangerous. I'm just taking some time off for a trip, what with how busy I've been lately.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Huh? Really?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Alright, time's up. Gotta go.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I heard that.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Wha?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Oh... I remember, you were there drilling while I was training Mel. What, you heard something?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: So what's this about taking time off?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Didn't I just say it's for a trip?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Yeah right.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Can't you trust me even a little?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Okay, so what's the destination?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Most governments don't welcome Infected tourists. Where are you going?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Oh dear, is Little Miss Teacher's Pet really so worried that I'm about to do something dangerous?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I'm not worried about YOU. I'm just worried about the trouble you'll—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Whatever, screw this song and dance.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Yes, I'm worried about you, alright? You were acting so distracted back there. If you ever need help, or just to talk, I'm here for you, okay?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Alright, alright... But I really don't need any help, I promise. It's not anything dangerous this time, just a personal matter.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: So how do you know so much about rapiers?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Et tu, Liskarm? Why's everyone so curious about this all of a sudden?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You wouldn't normally lose a match like that, but you did. And right after she brought it up.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It's my job to worry about my partner when she's not at the top of her game.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Alright. I'll tell you. I'm actually the successor to the Victorian Aubigny school of fencing. I was way too talented even, renowned across all of Londinium by the time I was seven.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: And apparently God Himself had a problem with that, because I caught Oripathy when I was eight for no apparent reason.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: After my master died, I left Victoria in search of the twelve surviving blades, forged by a legendary blacksmith.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: That's the plot of a Higashinese novel, isn't it?! Besides, you're Columbian!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Heheh...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Ahem. Truth is, I had a dream when I was eight. After I woke up, I went and followed that dream's guidance, all the way to this remote abandoned city.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Then I met a giant fowlbeast who used its own feathers to stab its prey. I was just a kid, but seeing that technique gave me a revelation—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: There are no fowlbeasts like that!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Huh. So that's not gonna fly either?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Alright then. So by pure chance, I met a Yanese swordmaster who taught me their secret techniques—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Come on. Stop fooling around.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: If you don't want to talk about it, then fine, forget I asked. Sorry for bringing it up.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Everyone's got things that are hard to talk about. No need to go through all that trouble just to hide it.
One month later...

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Um... Liskarm? Do you know if Franka's back yet?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You know, I just asked the Doctor about that.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: What did they say?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Nothing in particular, just that we shouldn't worry. She'll be back on schedule.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: I'm still worried about her, though. She seemed a little out of it before she left.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Relax, she'll be fine.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I believe in her.
Aw, how touching! Hey there, you two.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Franka!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Franka...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Honey, I'm home! Okay, Mel, let's get right to business. Let's see if you've gotten rusty this past month.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: A-Alright!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Haah—!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Slash!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Not bad, not bad. You haven't been slacking off, at least. You're connecting your slashes and thrusts much better now. Very nice.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Yeah... Um, Franka?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What's wrong? Did you suddenly notice how cool I am? Is this the birth of yet another Franka stan? In that case, feel free to hop right into my embrace.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: You look so much happier now. I'm glad.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Alright, alright. Let's continue your training. Have you been working on your basic stances?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: If I remember correctly, you come from a pretty well-off family, right?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: It's not worth bringing up...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: At the very least, they're more than capable of paying your medical bills, even if you didn't fight. You only started fencing as a way to stay fit, right?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Why fight, then?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Um, that's just because...

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: When my Oripathy was still in its early stages, it used to give me really heightened perception.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: And when I came to Rhodes Island, I saw how everyone was working so hard for their fellow Infected, so I thought... since I have this power, I should do something too.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: I should at least try.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: That's how it started, anyway. Since then, my perception's started to recede, and my parents... I haven't been able to get in touch with them for a long time.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: That's why I'm actually very glad that I made this choice. I met so many important friends, and... I can support myself now, even without my parents' help.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Mm. What an inspiring story.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: What about you? Why do you fight?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Because I'm a mercenary, of course.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Huh? But—

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Mel, count yourself lucky you found a reason to fight before actually having to do it~

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Anyway, you don't need to hear this next part.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hey, Teacher's Pet. So you finally found it?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Franka... What is that thing you left in my dorm room?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's a letter, duh.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: So you took that month off because...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hey, I'm back for debriefing, Doctor.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Thanks!

options: How've you been? Liskarm was worried.
Go see your partner. She's been worried.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Huh? Really? She's been bothering you about that? What a bitch. I should teach her a lesson.

options: It's so dull here without you two quarreling.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Really? You're so kind, Doctor.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Heehee, I didn't expect you to care about us so much.

options: You shouldn't always bottle it up inside.

steps.text: The Doctor's right.
I have to leave it behind before I can move forward.
And the best way to stop thinking about it might just be to... toss it out like yesterday's trash. Dump and forget.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Right, I was burying my mother.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You were asking how I'm so familiar with Mel's fencing, right?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Her style is basically the standard Victorian foil. It's the top choice among Victoria's upper-class women who want to stay in shape. Of course, it's mostly just for show. It's not all that practical.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: There's really nothing secret about it either. You familiarize yourself with the sword on your first lesson, learn your posture on your second, and how much force to use on your third... It's all the same no matter where you go.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: And I learned it myself years ago.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Hold on, didn't you just say it's used by the upper-classes?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Right. I... used to be something of a fancy-pants girl myself.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: My hometown's called Givogia. Big city in Columbia. Never heard of it, I'm guessing?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: That's because it was destroyed in a Catastrophe when I was thirteen.

steps.name: Young Franka
steps.text: Daddy... Daddy...

steps.name: Mother
steps.text: Don't! Franka! Don't go over there!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: My dad disappeared during the disaster. My mom and I just happened to be out in the countryside at the time.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: When we saw the Catastrophe clouds, we headed back right away, but... There was nothing left but ruins, buildings torn apart by Originium crystals.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: With the insurance payout plus our savings, we had enough to move to another city, but my mom soon got very sick from overwork.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So as soon as I graduated, I put my old fencing skills to work and became a mercenary—then I met Dr. Longfellow.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: As for what happened next, you've seen it all in my file at Blacksteel.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Oh, now that's not the face I was expecting! Don't worry, that was all a little joke~

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Why, you vixen—!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Alright, alright, don't get your panties in a bunch. That did actually happen. Seriously.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: That look you had just now was really rude, though.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I'm sorry, I—

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's okay. That was years ago. I've long since put it behind me. My mom's been sick for years, too. I was more than prepared for it.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: If you really feel bad about it, how about you treat me to tea?
This was why. This was exactly why I didn't want to tell anyone. I didn't want anyone looking at me with pity like that.
But... now that I've told her everything, it doesn't seem so important anymore.
It's all in the past. Should I be looking toward the future then?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Franka.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Excuse me? Miss Teacher's Pet wants to talk to me on the road?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Or are you still hung up on something... What's this?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I'm granting you a three month time-off. I think you need more time to get your head sorted out.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It'll be summer in a month. You can either choose to take it easy, or maybe go some place for a vacation.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Now, if you'll excuse me.

a.text: So you still remember my plans to go travelling.
What a unique way to comfort someone. It's just like you, though.
Maybe that future I've been looking forward to is... already here?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hey, Teacher's Pet... What do you say to coming on that vacation with me?
This is a letter that has been opened many, many times—

a.text: I got the money you sent me, but my treatment really doesn't cost that much. You don't have to keep sending me more.
My condition is still pretty stable. At the very least, I can still write this letter myself, so you really don't have to worry.
Remember to buy yourself some pretty dresses and jewelry. If you ever see anything you like, just buy it. Doll yourself up, and you'll feel better, trust me.
And if you still have any money left over, save it. It's dangerous to be a mercenary your whole life. You should retire as soon as you can afford to.
I was still so young when your father died. There were so many things I never had the chance to enjoy.

All the places I've never visited, all the foods I've never tasted, all the entertainment I've never had the chance to experience... You have to enjoy them for me. That's much more important than my health.
Oh, and of course the most important thing is that you're happy.
Finally... It's been three years since I last saw you, Sweetheart. When will you come home to pay me a visit?
